content.title: About Me
content.description:
Hi, I'm James, a coder, multi-instrumentalist, and screen composer.

As an experienced developer and music producer, I bridge the technical and creative aspects of each project. My current work includes full-stack web architectures, real-time interactive game development, and end-to-end creative production.

I have a reliable track record of moving seamlessly between front-end user interfaces, back-end services, gameplay systems, and building UX-optimized, scalable web apps.

My background in screen composition has served as a foundation to follow creative briefs and work collaboratively in cross-functional settings.

I grew up in Sydney, Australia and travelled the world before settling in Canada. My goal is to combine my skills and creative background as a composer, and my web and game development coding skills to build unique, beautiful and cutting edge projects that people have difficulty forgetting.
